deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using the YAML sensor platform is deprecated.

While importing your configuration for stop {stop_id}, Home Assistant could not reach the De Lijn API. This will be retried automatically on the next restart. Remove the existing YAML configuration and set the integration up via the UI once the import succeeds.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: {integration_title} YAML configuration deprecated

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using the YAML sensor platform is deprecated.

While importing your configuration for stop {stop_id}, the De Lijn API rejected the configured API key. Check the API key in your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the existing YAML configuration and set the integration up via the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.title: {integration_title} YAML configuration deprecated

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_sto.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using the YAML sensor platform is deprecated.

Stop {stop_id} from your YAML configuration no longer exists in De Lijn's data. Remove it from the `next_departure` list in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_sto.title: {integration_title} YAML configuration deprecated

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using the YAML sensor platform is deprecated.

An unexpected error occurred while importing your configuration for stop {stop_id}. Check the Home Assistant logs for details, then restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the existing YAML configuration and set the integration up via the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.title: {integration_title} YAML configuration deprecated
